content: Pole akesikighe yiswisu mu fundu dji banzonzi ba baSwife, novose yi: «Bane ba tadji, na matase malyome, nyisalili Nzambi tena na muni.»
Yivunde yi bavaghulitsi ba paghu Ananyase, akeveghe musughe ombu bobamabe beli na Pole, wumudimbe mu munu.
Kaboghu Pole akevaghe yi: «Nzambi aléwudimbe, na deti aghu! Wutsane vane mu ufundise nane mughaghe wirondili, mba wumabise mughaghe noveghe mu usughe wu undimbe!»
Abamabe va mughule Pole, bakemutsingule yi: «Yivunde yi bavaghulitsi ba paghu yi Nzambi wisyengi!»
Pole akewaghule yi, «Bane ba tadji, ngadjabaange yi yivunde yi bavaghulitsi ba paghu. Ngenze, Bisonu bi Nzambi bivosi yi: “Wughovose dibi mu yivunde yi mukute aghu!”»

Pole amadjabaange yi fundu djimabe djibase yari ayéyi baFarisi, yari ayine baSadisi. Ladibandu, amaghamuyile va wusu fundu dji banzonzi: «Bane ba tadji, nyidji muFarisi, mwane muFarisi. Nyifundusulu, mumba nyivu na yitu mu durambughulu du abafu.»
Mbé asekamane ne uvose, baFarisi na baSadisi bakebande utsunde, mba vakebe dupasu va ghari owu.
BaSadisi, bévosi yi vagha durambughulu o dufu, bemwévose yi vagha byanze na binyuni. Yotsu yine, baFarisi bémasingi yi mangenze.
Mighamu yike la viri. Milonzi mi mighaghe, abamabe na baFarisi, bakereleme notsunde na yikanene: «Tughélabi dibi mu mutu éwuwu. Tangudji yinyuni vo yanze yitsimuvosile?»
Mutsundu wukevyoghulile, tena yivunde yi baghore amawulu ghome bakéboke Pole. Ladibandu, amaveyile baghore bandi dirume dyuyébapatule Pole, nomughabuse o ghari ndaghu baghore.
Mukolu awumaduke, Fumu akelabene na Pole nomutsingule yi: «Ware! Wutsikabusile bumbedji o Serusaleme, na diwelimine wukelase bumbedji o musyengi Rome wandi.»
BaSwife bamatunge fundu djubokile Pole
Va kedi adjimaduke, baSwife baketunge fundu. Bakeleve pesi yi baghodji vo unu, pa bakaboke Pole.
Abamatunge fundu eni, bamabe bavyoghe maghumi-mana (40).
Bakérasene bivunde bi bavaghulitsi ba paghu na bivunde bi baSwife, mu batsingule yi: «Tutsileve pesi va wusu Nzambi yi tughodji yisalu, pa tukaboke Pole.
Kaboghu, djenu na fundu djotsu dji banzonzi, vaghanu yivunde yi baghore akebeghe Pole, dukefure yi dwirondi ukelule dyambu dyandi na burange. O yetu yari, tukunzeme mu muboke ne aketole vave.»
Tumbe mwane-katsi Pole, mwane yibusi yandi, amawulu fundu eni. Akewende o ndaghu baghore, akekote nolubuse Pole.
Kaboghu Pole akenengile yivunde yi baghore yimosi nomuvaghe yi: «Beghe munzambu éwuwu ombu yivunde, mumba ane mwa dyambu erondi umutsingule.»
Yivunde akemubeghe ombu yivunde yandi, novose yi: «Mwise tsughu winengulu Pole, atsipaghe nga wubeyile munzambu eni wuwu, mungo dyambu dyuwutsingule.»
Yivunde yi baghore akebonge munzambu mu dikake, akevengeme nandi nomuwivule yi: «Yi wirondi unzingule?»
Akewake yi: «Bidjeti bi baSwife batsiwulusunu mu wuwivule yi wukebeghe Pole mughese va wusu fundu djotsu dji banzonzi. Bofure yi bérondi uwulu dyambu dyandi burange.
Tumbe wuyabavayile yitu! Mumba abémutungili fundu bavyoghe ne maghumi-mana (40) ma batu. Batsileve pesi va wusu Nzambi yi baghodji vo unu, pa bakamuboke. Bamakunzeme na békeli yike musughe aghu.»
Yike emani urume munzambu yi ayavose dyambu dyeni na mutu, yivunde yi baghore akemughabuse.

Mba yivunde yi baghore akenengile batsyengi bandi babedji nobarume yi: «Ghukighanu kame-bedji (200) tsi baghore, na maghumi-dusambwali (70) ma babeyitsi ba bibulu na kame-bedji (200) tsi babaale na makongu, na banu djenu botsu na dubayi duwende o Sesaré, va maweru maryéru ma tsisighe.
Kunzanu bibulu duke beghe Pole na burange ombu yivunde yami Felikese.»
Mba akerende mughande eni wughu:
«Menu Kolode Lisyase, nyiwutindili mughade ewuwu mundumbe Felikese.
Dibale dyédidi, BaSwife batsighaange mbé baronde umuboke, kaboghu tutsimupatule na baghore bami va makake mowu, mumba nyimawulu yi adji mwise Rome.
Nyimaronde udjabe dibandu adi bamamufwengililaange, ngamubeghe va wusu fundu dji banzonzi ba baSwife.
Nyimaghulu yi bémufwengilili mu mighaghe mi djobeni, tumbe aghane mbele dufu vo dji tsughu.
Mba nyilubusi yi vadji fundu bamutungile. Nzilenge nomutinde ombu waghu na nyivayi bambeni bandi bakeyimufunde va wusu aghu.»
Baghore bakededile marume ame bamadile. Bakebonge Pole nomubeghe mukolu o musyengi Atipareti.
Yilumbu ayimaduke, baghore abamabe mu makulu bakeghabughe o ndaghu owu, nosile babeyitsi ba bibulu uwende na Pole.
Na bétoli o Sesaré, babeyitsi ba bibulu bakeveghe yivunde mughande, nomuwakise Pole va makake mowu.
Dipateme anomane urange mughande, akemuwivule yari yi dimbu dyandi. Anowulu yi mwise Silisi,
akemuvaghe yi: «Nyuwusosise pa bambeni baghu bamarughe.» Na akeveghe musughe wukelise Pole o ndaghu kaghe Yirode.
